title: Digital beamformer on GPUs
highlights: generate_signals kernel creates modulated signals with per-element phase delays.
Measured: time-domain beamforming about 0.025 ms, with the kernel itself about 0.024 ms.
Frequency-domain path uses cuFFT forward and inverse FFTs.
Grid and block sizes are chosen per array size, with error handling around every CUDA and cuFFT call.
summary: A CUDA digital beamformer with a time-domain path and a cuFFT frequency-domain path. Time-domain beamforming runs in about 0.025 ms.
